newsitem.title: USA: PG&E Ca. nuclear unit trips off line--NRC.
newsitem.headline: PG&E Ca. nuclear unit trips off line--NRC.

text.p: Pacific Gas and Electric Co's 1,087 megawatt (MW) Diablo Canyon 1 nuclear power unit in Avila Beach, Ca., has tripped off line, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said in its Monday morning report.
The unit automatically shut down late Friday "due to a fire in an auxiliary power grounding transformer," the NRC said.
A tentative restart date has been set for Wednesday, the report stated.
The adjacent 1,073 MW unit is operating at full power.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
